card.name: Dense graphs on 16 vertices without the cube Q3

task.name: Dense graphs on 16 vertices without the cube Q3
task.description: construct() -> list of edges [u, v] of a simple graph on vertices 0..15 containing no subgraph isomorphic to the 3-cube Q3 (exact search). Maximize the number of edges. A Q3-free graph with m edges certifies ex(16;Q3) >= m; no exact value for n = 16 is documented.
task.contract: construct() -> list of edges [u, v] of a simple graph on vertices 0..15 containing no subgraph isomorphic to the 3-cube Q3 (exact search). Maximize the number of edges.
